description: This Java source file defines the 'SeoCatalogUrlServlet' class, a servlet handling SEO-friendly URL routing for product and category pages within an e-commerce application. It processes URL paths to extract product and category IDs, manages category trails, and generates SEO URLs.

classes.name: SeoCatalogUrlServlet
classes.description: A servlet class that handles SEO-friendly URL routing for product and category pages, parsing URL paths to identify product and category IDs, managing category trails, and forwarding requests accordingly.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests by delegating to doGet method.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Processes incoming GET requests, extracts product and category IDs from URL path, manages category trail, sets request attributes, and forwards to appropriate JSP page.

methods.name: makeCatalogUrl
methods.description: Generates an SEO-friendly URL for a product or category based on current and previous category IDs, including category trail adjustments.

methods.name: makeCatalogUrl
methods.description: Overloaded method that constructs a catalog URL from context path, breadcrumb list, product ID, current and previous category IDs, with category trail adjustments.
